Desmopressin treats central, not nephrogenic, diabetes insipidus
Recheck U&E and creatinine 1 to 2 weeks after diuretic changes
reference.pathophysiology: Filtered sodium reclamation along proximal tubule, loop, distal tubule and collecting duct is sequentially gated by distinct transporters and aldosterone, so site specific blockade predicts urine volume and electrolyte fingerprints. Vasopressin V2 aquaporin insertion governs free water excretion oppositely, and its absence or renal resistance produces the diabetes insipidus spectrum distinguished by desmopressin response.
